references.text: Psalm 105:1 encourages praising the Lord and calling on his name, which reflects the idea of God speaking through the holy ones mentioned in Luke 1:70.
Isaiah 63:7 speaks of the Lord's mercies and his praiseworthy deeds, aligning with the concept of God speaking through the prophets as noted in Luke 1:70.
Micah 3:5 criticizes false prophets, indirectly highlighting the importance of the true prophets through whom God spoke, as referenced in Luke 1:70.
Zechariah 7:12 describes how the ancestors did not listen to the Lord's word that came through his Spirit and prophets, mirroring the concept in Luke 1:70 of God speaking through his holy prophets.
Matthew 1:22-23 refers to the fulfillment of the prophecy concerning Jesus' birth, illustrating an example of God's word expressed through the prophets, as mentioned in Luke 1:70.
